title: Predictive Spatio-Temporal Scene Graphs for Semi-Static Scenes
summary: PredictiveGraphs combines open-vocabulary scene mapping, language-model assistance, and state persistence modeling to predict where semi-static objects will be. The paper evaluates simulation tasks and 25 real-world queries during a three-week laboratory collection; this is a bounded robotics demonstration, not long-term deployment.
ai_technology: CLIP embeddings and an LLM verifier/planner support object recognition and scene queries; a Bayesian persistence filter predicts object-receptacle states.
organization: Not stated in the reviewed arXiv full text

evidence.tested: Evaluation covered 250 predictive and 125 adaptive simulation queries and 25 open-vocabulary real-world queries during three weeks in a laboratory.
evidence.unknown: Bounded laboratory evaluation; not sustained deployment, and the paper notes potential language-model hallucinations.
evidence.ai_role: The learned scene-state system predicts object locations over time and enables time-aware navigation queries.

source_review.scope: Primary source full-text Methods and Results; version date and reported validation scope checked.
